note: SYNTHETIC roles and knowledge-base entitlements. Permissions are applied BEFORE retrieval.
conflict_rule: If approved units disagree: higher authority wins and the answer notes the override. If they have EQUAL authority, return outcome=conflict and route to both owners. Never let the model pick.

hard_partitions.note: Applied before any search: tenant, environment, line of business and state jurisdiction.

two_index_design: Body index: unit text, filtered by entitlement before search; only this ever reaches the model. Routing index: unit_id, title, knowledge_base and owner team only (no body), searched across all units so a restricted match returns not_authorized with the owning team instead of a false insufficient_evidence. Titles must be written so they are safe to expose.
resolution_order: eligible (status approved, within effective and review dates, entitlement)
applicable (line of business, state, plan year, audience, channel)
recency (later effective_date wins only within equal authority and identical applicability)
